errors.text_span: ranging from 64 to 256 on a linear scale
errors.evidence: The x-axis does not represent a continuous linear range. It shows four discrete, non-uniformly spaced values: 1632, 64, 128, and 256.
The red dashed line for the Transformer model is at a constant Eval PPL of approximately 11.6, as it is visibly only slightly above the 11.5 gridline.
The description misidentifies the starting point of the MoHD line. The first data point is at 1632 sub-dims with a value of approximately 10.4. At 64 sub-dims, the value is higher, around 10.45.
The description incorrectly reports the value at 256 sub-dims. The value at 256 is approximately 10.6. The peak value for the MoHD line is at 128 sub-dims (approx. 10.65), not at 256.
